items.title: Dipole moment aur molecules ki polarity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered Dipole Moment topic, printed pages 51-52.

blocks.text: HF jaise compounds mein, jahan bonded atoms do alag elements ke hon, atoms ke beech electrons barabar nahi bante (uneven distribution, yani ghair barabar baant). Is wajah se ek atom par partial (thora sa) positive aur doosre par partial negative charge aa jata hai.

blocks.title: Dipole
blocks.text: Jis molecule ke ek hisse par δ⁺ aur doosre hisse par δ⁻ charge ho, use dipole kehte hain, aur aise molecule ka dipole moment hota hai.

Dipole moment kisi bond ya molecule ki polarity ka quantitative (number mein) measure hai. HF, HCl, HBr, HI, NO jaise diatomic molecules ka dipole moment positive end (δ⁺) se negative end (δ⁻) ki taraf hota hai (Fig. 3.5). Dipole moment Debye unit (D) mein napa jata hai. Zyada dipole moment ka matlab zyada polarity.

blocks.alt: Baen: HF ke electron cloud ki dots wali tasveer, fluorine nucleus ke gird hydrogen nucleus se zyada ghani. Daen: H (delta+) bari F (delta-) se juri, aur H se F ki taraf crossed arrow (teer) dipole dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5: HF mein electron density F atom ke qareeb zyada hai aur dipole moment H se F ki taraf hai (kitab ki Figure 3.5 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Do se zyada atoms wale compounds mein dipole moment molecule ki shape par depend karta hai. Pani ka dipole moment 1.85 D hai, jo do hydrogen atoms wale end se oxygen wale end ki taraf hai (Fig. 3.6). Agar H₂O seedha (linear, H–O–H) hota to us ka dipole moment zero hota. Dipole moment zero nahi, is liye pani linear nahi hai; experiments batate hain ke pani v-shaped hai. SO₂ ka dipole moment 1.61 D hai aur us ki direction pani se ulti hai. H₂S bhi non-linear hai: us ke bonds polar hain, woh ek doosre ko cancel nahi karte, is liye poore molecule ka kuch dipole moment hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: mura hua H2O molecule, O par delta- aur har H par delta+; har O-H bond ke saath crossed arrow H se O ki taraf, aur seedha natija (resultant) arrow oopar O ki taraf; P = 1.85 D. Daen: mura hua SO2, S par delta+ aur har O par delta-; bond moment arrow S se O ki taraf aur natija neeche, S se door; P = 1.61 D. Neeche: pani ka rangeen electron density naqsha, oxygen sira laal aur hydrogen sira neela, aur chhapa note ke dipole moment neele se laal ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6: Bent (mure hue) H2O aur SO2 molecules mein alag alag bond moments ka vector addition (jama) (kitab ki Figure 3.6 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Lekin kuch molecules ka dipole moment zero hota hai, kyun ke un ki shape symmetrical (dono taraf ek jaisi) hoti hai aur alag alag bond moments ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain. Maslan BeCl₂ linear hai: beech wale atom ke dono taraf 180° par do ek jaise Cl atoms hain. Do Be–Cl bond moments barabar aur ulti direction mein hain, is liye cancel ho jate hain. Isi tarah CCl₄ ke chaar C–Cl bonds, C aur Cl ki electronegativity mein bare farq ki wajah se, kaafi polar hain; lekin chaar bond moments aisi directions mein hain ke ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain. CCl₄ ka net dipole moment zero hai, is liye woh non-polar hai. CCl₄ bilkul tetrahedral hai. BF₃ bhi symmetrical trigonal planar hai aur us ka dipole moment bhi zero hai. Rule (qaida): jis molecule mein beech wale atom ke saath ek jaise ligands (atoms ya atoms ke groups) regular shape mein hon, us ke alag bond moments zero na bhi hon, poore molecule ka dipole moment zero hota hai. Aisa molecule non-polar kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen symmetrical molecules, har ek ke neeche p = 0 D. BeCl2 seedha (linear), Cl-Be-Cl, 180 degree ki qaus ke saath. BF3 tikona, B par delta+, har F par delta- aur har B-F bond ke saath F ki taraf bond moment arrow. CCl4 tetrahedral khaake mein, C par delta+, har Cl par delta- aur har C-Cl bond ke saath Cl ki taraf arrow. Moments ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.7: Symmetrical molecules BeCl2, BF3 aur CCl4 mein alag alag bond moments khatam ho kar net dipole moment zero dete hain (kitab ki Figure 3.7 ke mutabiq original drawing; chhapa caption CH4 kehta hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 3.7 ki caption mein CH₄ likha hai, lekin figure aur text dono CCl₄ dikhate hain. Is liye yahan caption mein CCl₄ likha gaya hai; CCl₄ mein chaar C–Cl bond moments ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain.

blocks.prompt: a) CO ka dipole moment kyun hai jabke CO₂ ka nahi?
blocks.explanation: CO do alag atoms ka molecule hai; us ka akela bond polar hai, is liye molecule dipole hai. CO₂ linear hai (O=C=O): us ke do polar C=O bond moments barabar aur ulti direction mein hain, cancel ho jate hain, is liye net dipole moment zero.

blocks.prompt: b) Kya CCl₄ ke alag alag bonds polar hain? Poore CCl₄ molecule ki polarity kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Haan, har C–Cl bond polar hai kyun ke chlorine carbon se kaafi zyada electronegative hai. Lekin chaar bonds regular tetrahedron ke corners ki taraf hain aur un ke moments cancel ho jate hain, is liye poora CCl₄ non-polar hai.

blocks.prompt: c) HF, CH₂Cl₂, O₂ aur H₂S polar hain ya non-polar? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: HF: polar (do alag atoms). CH₂Cl₂: polar (C par do H aur do Cl; bond moments barabar nahi, cancel nahi hote). O₂: non-polar (do ek jaise atoms). H₂S: polar (bent molecule; bond moments cancel nahi hote).

items: Dipole ke do end hote hain, δ⁺ aur δ⁻; dipole moment (Debye, D) polarity batata hai aur δ⁺ se δ⁻ ki taraf hota hai (HF mein H se F).
Shape net moment decide karti hai: bent H₂O (1.85 D) aur SO₂ (1.61 D) polar hain; symmetrical BeCl₂, BF₃ aur CCl₄ ka moment zero hai aur woh non-polar hain.
